- "Okay, number [X]."
- "You get the idea."
- "Here's how the math works out."
- "Here's how it could work."
- "Quick break in the pod..."
- "That's huge."
- "That's insane."
- "It's sipping time, baby."
- "Time to sip."
- "Let's keep going."
- "You still with me?"
- "Shh, don't tell anyone."
- "Welcome to 2025, baby."
- "That's the pod."
